detail.title: Experimental Distinctions Between Autocatalytic Memory and Template-Directed Heredity
detail.summary: Revised analysis examining how stoichiometric conditions and thermodynamic frameworks support non-equilibrium autocatalytic memory versus template-directed heredity.
detail.reason: Synthesizing recent evidence to refine the distinction between autocatalytic subsystems and heredity.
